memory_update.text: ALAB is the reference pure-play for AI fabric connectivity plumbing but is no longer an underfollowed small/mid-cap; use it as a benchmark, not as discovery alpha.
CRDO remains a high-priority AI fabric candidate due to AEC, SerDes, optical DSP, and PCIe retimer exposure, but customer concentration must be treated as a central risk and verification item.
SMTC maps to the signal-integrity edge of the AI fabric node; the key gating evidence is whether data-center Signal Integrity growth is specifically tied to AI cluster 800G/1.6T deployments.

AEHR is a speculative-shadow candidate for AI interconnect reliability test and silicon-photonics burn-in, not a direct fabric silicon supplier; survival into later layers requires proof of recurring AI/silicon-photonics production orders.

Need a separate pass on connector and cable-assembly suppliers such as APH/TEL and possibly optical module or silicon-photonics suppliers, because this pass prioritized merchant silicon, signal integrity, and test.

node: AI fabric interconnect silicon and board-level connectivity
summary: Expanded the AI fabric interconnect plumbing node with a two-lane universe: one reference pure-play already recognized by the market, plus underfollowed or second-order suppliers tied to active electrical cables, signal-integrity silicon, high-speed analog/photonic components, and reliability test equipment. This pass intentionally avoids GPU and hyperscaler mega-cap crowding. The strongest direct evidence sits with Astera Labs and Credo; Semtech and Aehr are included as underfollowed/adjacent chokepoint hypotheses requiring segment-level verification.
